title: [finding] spec(migrations): the published entry page-template-closed-region-unplaced-refused says a stored page with an unplaced region or an unregistered template "renders as before"; objectui#12476 makes it render a refusal
body:
Filing gate ①, exception "release-fixed wrong text": the shipped migration entry's text, from the os-dev report on objectstack-ai/objectui#12476 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12901, out-of-scope finding, class b). Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

## What

`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.page-template-closed-region-unplaced-refused.ts` (objectstack `main`), shipped in `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.2` and `next.3`, ends its `reason` with: "A page row already stored with an unregistered template or an unplaced region is served unchanged and renders as before, while saving it again is refused until it is renamed." `build-upgrade-guide.ts` renders that text into the upgrade guide.

- It was true of objectui `main` when it shipped: the console stacked an unplaced region under `main` and laid an unregistered template out as the page type's layout.
- objectui#12476 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12901, the ruling's item 5 follow-up) retires that fallback per the maintainer ruling (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23610, record `6190536588`, Q2 A: the renderer keeps no fallback for a shape the spec refuses). Once it lands, such a stored row is served unchanged but renders a visible refusal naming the region (or template) and the template's slots, in place of the region.
- The entry's `acceptanceCriteria` (rename, then each renamed region draws in its slot) stays right.

**reach:** exception: release-text. The sentence is published in the upgrade guide an operator reads before upgrading; after the console upgrade it describes a page that no longer draws.

## Expected

The entry's `reason` says what an operator will see: a stored row with an unregistered template or an unplaced region is served unchanged, its save is refused until renamed, and the console draws a refusal in its place (naming the region or template and the slots) until it is renamed.

**Reader who acts:** objectstack triage, then `domain:spec`. The landing is that one entry's `reason` (and the regenerated upgrade guide, if it is committed). Precedent: objectstack-ai/objectstack#20860, a finding on another published entry's wording.

**Dedupe** (open and closed): objectstack issues searched for "upgrade guide migration page-template-closed-region-unplaced-refused renders as before stored row unplaced region": 2 hits, objectstack-ai/objectstack#23317 (closed, `os migrate meta --stored` families) and #20860 (closed, another entry's wording). Neither names this entry.

Dedupe words: page-template-closed-region-unplaced-refused, renders as before, unplaced region stored row refusal, upgrade guide page template.
